Salam's blood-stained shirt fired Patuakhali's Language Movement
2023-02-12T15:58:19+06:00 | Star Special
https://www.thedailystar.net/star-multimedia/news-multimedia/news/salams-blood-stained-shirt-fired-patuakhalis-language-movement-3245716

People from all walks of life took part in the Language Movement of 1952 in Patuakhali, like other parts of the country, with the slogan "Rashtro Bhasha Bangla Chai".

In the 71st years of the language movement, watch today's Star Special to know about Patuakhali's contribution.
